lenses.label: Horálek optical
lenses.description: Visible-light colors from Petr Horálek's NOIRLab wide-field photograph, painted onto the shared image-fitted LMC emission model. Its broad envelope follows the Garver et al. stellar simulation's shape hypothesis, not measured gas depth.

lenses.label: ESO VISTA
lenses.description: Near-infrared colors from ESO's VISTA VMC survey image, painted onto the shared image-fitted LMC emission model. Its broad envelope follows the Garver et al. stellar simulation's shape hypothesis, not measured gas depth.

lenses.label: NASA AllWISE
lenses.description: Infrared colors from the NASA/IPAC AllWISE color mosaic served by CDS, painted onto the shared image-fitted LMC emission model. Its broad envelope follows the Garver et al. stellar simulation's shape hypothesis, not measured gas depth.
